SELECT cls,
       CAST(fish_date_doy/10 AS INT)*10 AS bucket,
       COUNT(*) AS n_trips,
       SUM(yt) AS total_yt,
       SUM(anglers) AS total_anglers,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 274 AND 306
  AND cls IN ('DAY_1_5','OVERNIGHT','THREE_QUARTER')
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2
